failed_hard_gates.evidence: The face and handwheel contacts are assessable, but the final reviewed visibility plan also cited the complete short drive linkage and its endpoints. The mechanism crop shows an upper rod meeting the louver pivot, while its lower end meets a frame cross-member; a continuous crank-to-rod connection from the large wheel is not visible. The full reviewed endpoint plan therefore cannot pass. This is a visibility/realization limit, not a diagnosis of unseen anatomy.
